Owner(s).note: The 2024 environmental statement of EVH GmbH and its Trotha plant company calls the Dieselstraße energy park an EVH site. A local news article from December 2016 says the Trotha plant now belongs completely to EVH through its subsidiary Heizkraftwerk Halle-Trotha GmbH. So EVH GmbH holds both sites, but for the Trotha site the direct holder is the subsidiary. See the question about which site these units are at.
